name: docs
description: The sail-proxy documentation site (VitePress). Built and deployed to GitHub Pages.

scripts.prepare-assets: node scripts/copy-fonts.mjs && node scripts/sync-root-files.mjs && node scripts/sync-openapi.mjs && node scripts/gen-endpoints.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare-assets && vitepress build && node scripts/check-base.mjs && node scripts/check-styles.mjs && node scripts/check-anchors.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run test && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/check-titles.mjs && node scripts/check-mustache.mjs && node scripts/check-videos.mjs && node ../screencast/check.js && node ../screencast/lib/narration-check.mjs && pnpm run build
